name: header

examples.instructions: Below 64em (1024px), initialize the header and activate Menu. The navigation opens as a drawer over a page overlay; USWDS moves focus to Close, keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside the drawer, and hides the rest of the page from assistive technology until Close, the overlay, a navigation link, or Escape closes it.

description: A Colorado-themed USWDS basic header with a replaceable site logo, a labelled primary navigation, and the USWDS mobile navigation drawer below 64em.
